ReviewScope: Independent source-contract, repair diff, regression assertion and immutable baseline/reference review. No code edits; no MATLAB runtime execution.

ObservedOwnerReturn.CommonFailure: MATLAB:nonExistentField, SourceId, observe line 333 during first source ACK observation

RootCause: Frames.base gives every frame an App field; ACK App is a fieldless scalar struct. The old isfield(frame,App) condition dereferenced DATA-specific SourceId/Id on a valid ACK.
Disposition: The DATA-kind guard matches the actual constructors and callbacks. ACK/NONE keep zero application identity; malformed DATA still fails explicitly.
RegressionCoverage: Real acknowledgment constructor retains Kind ACK and fieldless scalar App.
All six boundary rows are required before iteration; no empty-loop pass for this regression.
First real source aggregate retains ACK app identity 0/0 and DATA identity 5/3.
Every ACK observation in aggregate_tx, ack_tx and feedback_ingress has zero app identity.
Previously vacuous delivery and ACK/drain tests now assert six boundary rows and the exact ordered case identities before iterating.
RemainingAccessAudit: selectedMembers uses short-circuit && after strcmp(b.Kind,DATA) before b.App.SourceId/Id.
Prime and ingress DATA frames are built by Frames.data, which validates required application fields.
deliver receives the NWK Delivered application callback and creates an explicit Kind DATA observation.
settled uses struct(), retains NONE kind and zero identity.
Sequence and ACK/DACK bitmap reads remain isfield-guarded; MAC queue and transmission counters come from the existing MAC schema.
Limitation: The failure prevented the original owner run from reaching the target ACK boundary in all six cases. Repair correctness is source-reviewed; runtime closure and timing/parity conclusions require the new owner t14.zip.
